# Mira plugins

<!-- Generated by `mira docs` from the plugin specs. Do not edit by hand; run `mira docs` instead. -->

Every plugin of both machines, with the knobs it owns. Bounds are hard limits for every writer; the agent column is what Hermes may set by voice (always a trial).

## Machine: listener

### agc.mic

Software gain stage on the mic chunks.

- version 1; provides: agc; needs: nothing; reads: reporter.agentos.level_scale; required; on by default; toggle restart

| key | type | default | bounds | unit | applies | agent | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| on | bool | true |  |  | restart | deny | Software gain stage on the mic. |
| target | float | 0.05 | 0.005..0.3 | rms | live | 0.03..0.1 step 0.01 | Speech level the gain aims for. |
| max_gain | float | 10 | 1..40 | x | live | 4..14 step 2 | Most the gain may rise. |
| rest | float | 3 | 1..40 | x | live | deny | Gain in a quiet room; re-clamped to 1..max_gain on apply. |
| gate | float | 1.8 | 1..6 | x floor | live | deny | How far above the noise floor counts as speech. |
| release | float | 0.25 | 0.01..1 | per chunk | live | deny | How fast the gain rises. |
| decay | float | 0.03 | 0.001..0.5 | per chunk | live | deny | How fast the gain relaxes to rest in silence. |
| min_rms | float | 0.001 | 0..0.05 | rms | live | deny | Absolute floor of the speech test. |
| ceiling | float | 0.9 | 0.1..1 | peak | live | deny | No-clip limit. |
| floor_init | float | 0.003 | 0..0.1 | rms | restart | deny | Starting noise floor (the JV603 hiss). |
| floor_rate_speech | float | 0.0005 | 0..0.1 | rate | live | deny | Noise floor tracking rate during speech. |
| floor_rate_low | float | 0.2 | 0..1 | rate | live | deny | Noise floor tracking rate when the chunk is below the floor. |
| floor_rate_mid | float | 0.05 | 0..1 | rate | live | deny | Noise floor tracking rate for any other chunk. |

### brain.hermes

Hermes through Agent OS's session API.

- version 1; provides: brain; needs: persona; required; on by default; toggle restart

| key | type | default | bounds | unit | applies | agent | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| url | url | http://127.0.0.1:8642 |  |  | live | deny | Hermes api_server address. |
| key_file | path | (secret path) |  |  | live | deny | Bearer key file, read per call. |
| session_ttl | float | 180 | 30..1800 | s | live | 60..600 step 60 | Idle time before she starts a fresh conversation. |
| session_timeout_s | float | 15 | 3..60 | s | live | deny | Seconds creating a session may take. |
| stream_timeout_s | float | 150 | 10..600 | s | live | deny | Seconds one socket read of the answer may wait. |
| title_prefix | str | Mira wall | 1..60 chars | chars | live | deny | Start of every session title. |
| fail_reply | str | I cannot reach Hermes right now. | 1..200 chars | chars | live | deny | Spoken when Hermes cannot be reached. |

### intent.calendar

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

### loop.turns

- version 1; provides: loop; needs: nothing; required; on by default; toggle restart; core slot

| key | type | default | bounds | unit | applies | agent | description |

| sigterm_idle | bool | false |  |  | restart | deny | SIGTERM posts a final idle and exits through the finally. |

### mute.zero

Detects the hardware mute of the USB mic from runs of digital zeros.

- version 1; provides: mute; needs: nothing; required; on by default; toggle restart

| key | type | default | bounds | unit | applies | agent | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| mute_s | float | 10 | 2..60 | s | live | deny | Seconds of zero samples before the mic counts as muted. |
| mute_share | float | 0.99 | 0.5..1 | share | live | deny | Share of exact zeros that makes a block muted. |
| live_share | float | 0.9 | 0.5..1 | share | live | deny | A block under this share of zeros is live; must not exceed mute_share. |
| block_s | float | 1 | 0.5..5 | s | restart | deny | Length of one verdict block. |
| repeat_s | float | 60 | 10..600 | s | live | deny | Seconds between re-posts of muted so a restarted Agent OS learns it. |
